draft.subject: Your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Owen,

Thanks again for making time for the onboarding call last week. Since then I haven't wanted to pile on emails, so this is a short one.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so getting one real project in place is usually the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and whenever you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm glad to set up that first project with you live.

Best,
Nadia
